request: Read a PLC tag into a local buffer

candidates.prompt: One square software icon on pure white: A blue industrial controller on left, bold black right arrow, orange tag on right. Symbolize reading a PLC tag into a local buffer. Thick simple flat geometry, generous margins, no text, border or shadow.

signature.composition: A blue industrial controller on left, bold black right arrow, orange tag on right.

source.evidence: A blue PLC rack points toward an orange tag.

29x29.evidence: Rack, arrow and tag are visible.

30x23.evidence: Rack details begin to merge; arrow and tag remain.

30x18.evidence: The PLC-to-tag composition is a mirror of the write-tag PLC-and-tag concept.
30x18.cause: The same overall shapes recur in another option or opposing VI.
30x18.correction: Choose a visibly different transfer composition from both read and write options.

16x16.evidence: Rack becomes a blue block and arrow becomes small.

candidates.prompt: One square software icon on pure white: A large blue tag being pulled leftward by a bold orange arrow. Symbolize reading a PLC tag into a local buffer. Thick simple flat geometry, generous margins, no text, border or shadow.

signature.composition: A large blue tag being pulled leftward by a bold orange arrow.

source.evidence: An orange arrow leaves a blue tag to the left with no PLC or buffer shown.

30x18.evidence: The outgoing arrow can be read as extracting a value or sending data, not specifically reading a PLC tag.

30x18.correction: Show a clearly identifiable source and destination for the read action.

candidates.prompt: One square software icon on pure white: A bold blue downward arrow into an orange tray containing a tag silhouette. Symbolize reading a PLC tag into a local buffer. Thick simple flat geometry, generous margins, no text, border or shadow.

signature.composition: A bold blue downward arrow into an orange tray containing a tag silhouette.

source.evidence: A blue down arrow enters a tray with a small orange tag.

29x29.evidence: Arrow, tray and tag are visible.

30x18.evidence: The tag and tray merge, obscuring the object being read.
30x18.cause: Tag and tray have the same orange fill and are crowded.
30x18.correction: Separate and contrast the tag from the receiving tray.
